title: Module review
subtitle: Everything about Sémillon
objectives: Compare its dry and sweet styles

steps.prompt: Why does Sémillon suit noble rot?

steps.explanation: Sémillon's two great homes are Bordeaux and the Hunter.

steps.prompt: Hunter Sémillon is picked very ripe, at 14% alcohol.
steps.explanation: Not true. It's picked early, at 10 to 11%.

steps.prompt: Sémillon is usually blended with Sauvignon ____ in Bordeaux.
steps.explanation: Sauvignon Blanc adds acidity and aroma.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Sémillon is waxy, lemony and ages beautifully
It's the heart of Sauternes, thanks to thin skins
Hunter Valley makes unoaked Sémillon that turns toasty
It pairs from oysters to foie gras
